question: What contract terms (initial length and any renewal or extension options) do the actuarial services RFPs in the corpus propose?
gold_answer: Boston BRS actuarial: five years (2023–2027), option for one or two additional years. COAERS: five-year Master Services Agreement for 2026–2030 with annual engagement letters; no explicit renewal term. Illinois SRS: five years, July 1, 2024–June 30, 2029; no specified extension option. LACERS: three years, potentially two one-year extensions. Stoneham: no more than seven years, with 30-day termination right; no separate renewal option. KCERA actuarial audit: one year from final contract execution, no specified extension. St. Louis PRS actuarial auditor: one-time engagement, retaining an option to renew without a specified renewal duration. AVFPD OPEB actuarial: no express fixed initial contract length; scope covers valuations/roll-forwards dated 2024–2029 and funding recommendations FY2025–2030, and refers to optional extensions with fees negotiated at extension without defining their length.
acceptance: Accept alternative order/wording of the eight applicable sources. AVFPD service years are not an expressly fixed contract term; St. Louis one-time is not one year. Annual COAERS engagement letters are not renewal options. If the question is narrowed to five named RFPs, the original five-item answer becomes sufficient.
candidate_answer:
The actuarial-services RFPs propose these terms. Where an RFP gives no specific renewal period, I have not inferred one.

| RFP | Initial term and renewal or extension option |
|---|---|
| [Stoneham, pp. 3, 5](Stoneham_MA__Request-for-proposals---Actuarial-Services-PDF.pdf#page=3) | Agreement **not to exceed seven years**, covering the 2020, 2022, and 2024 valuations. It does not separate an initial term from an extension option. |
| [Boston, p. 5](Boston__RFP_Actuarial_and_Consulting_Services_for_Pension_Benefits_08-30-2022.pdf#page=5) | **Five years**, with the Board able to extend it for **one or two additional years** without readvertising. |
| [Illinois SRS, pp. 3, 34](Illinois_SRS__RFP--Actuarial_Consulting_Services--SRS.pdf#page=3) | **Five years**, July 1, 2024–June 30, 2029; no specific renewal option stated. |
| [COAERS, pp. 4, 18](COAERS__COAERS_Actuarial_Services_RFP_June_26_2025.pdf#page=4) | **Five-year master agreement**, January 1, 2026–December 31, 2030, with annual engagement letters; no specific extension option stated. |
| [LACERS, p. 3](LACERS__2025_actuarial_consulting_services_rfp.pdf#page=3) | **Three years**, potentially followed by **up to two one-year extensions**. |
| [Apple Valley Fire Protection District, pp. 3–4](AVFPD__RFP-Actuatial-Services-2024.pdf#page=3) | Work is specified through **June 2029**—2024, 2026, and 2028 valuations plus intervening roll-forwards. The RFP mentions **optional contract extensions**, with fees negotiated when exercised, but does not specify their length or a separately stated initial contract term. |
| [St. Louis Police Retirement System, p. 7](St_Louis_PRS__PRS_Actuarial_Auditor_Services_RFP_and_Questionnaire.pdf#page=7) | An initial **one-time engagement**, with PRS retaining an **option to renew**; no renewal length is specified. |
| [KCERA, p. 17](KCERA__RFP_2024_Actuarial_Audit_Final_-_with_Sample_Agreement.pdf#page=17) | **One year** from final contract execution; no renewal option stated. |
